title: People’s Mañanera September 8
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**53% Fewer Homicides: Peace Is Built from the Ground Up  
** From September 2024 to August 2026, the daily average number of homicides
fell from 86.9 to 40.8, the lowest level in 12 years. President Claudia
Sheinbaum stated that "there can be no security strategy without addressing
the root causes" of violence. Under AMLO, the upward trend in such crimes was
halted, and under Sheinbaum, the decline is accelerating.

**Guaranteeing Rights Is Also Building Peace  
** In two years, 578,000 door-to-door healthcare visits were conducted and 933
Peace Fairs were held. The Fourth Transformation (4T) is expanding
opportunities: 400,000 new spaces in educational institutions, 416,000 young
people participating in the "Youth Building the Future" program, and more than
7,000 in "Youth Uniting the Neighborhood."

**70% Reduction in Fentanyl Trafficking to the United States  
** Through coordination, fentanyl trafficking has been reduced, but Sheinbaum
emphasized that the U.S. must combat consumption, distribution networks, and
money laundering: "They have a very important role to play there," she
explained.

**Governing Mexico Means Swearing Allegiance to a Single Flag  
** The President maintained that anyone aspiring to govern Mexico must hold
only Mexican citizenship. "You cannot be president and swear allegiance to two
flags; only one—the Mexican flag. You swear allegiance only to the people of
Mexico," she said.

**Sheinbaum Proposes Investigating Possible Interference on Social Media  
** Sheinbaum proposed that Congress investigate the activities in Mexico of
Fernando Cerimedo, Javier Negre, and the right-wing La Derecha Diario, in
light of possible efforts to influence public opinion through social media,
resources, bots, AI, and fake news. "It wouldn't hurt," she noted.
